title.zh: 将布拉干省哈戈诺伊市镇哈戈诺伊急诊医院的名称变更为Emilio G. Perez市长纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Hagonoy Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Bulacan, to Mayor Emilio G. Perez Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Hagonoy Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Bulacan, to Mayor Emilio G. Perez Memorial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Hagonoy Emergency Hospital tại Thị trấn Hagonoy, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Bệnh viện tưởng niệm Mayor Emilio G. Perez
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Hagonoy Emergency Hospital ในเทศบาล Hagonoy, จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Mayor Emilio G. Perez
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Hagonoy Emergency Hospital di Kotamadya Hagonoy, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Rumah Sakit Peringatan Mayor Emilio G. Perez
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Hagonoy Emergency Hospital di Perbandaran Hagonoy, Wilayah Bulacan menjadi Hospital Peringatan Mayor Emilio G. Perez

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6433_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Hagonoy Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Bulacan is hereby changed to Mayor Emilio G. Perez Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 17, 1972.
